name: std::wstring_convert<Codecvt,Elem,Wide_alloc,Byte_alloc>::state
intro: Returns the current value of the conversion state, which is stored in this wstring_convert object. The conversion state may be explicitly set in the constructor and is updated by all conversion operations.
